stringUnit.value: The source acknowledged this request. Reload to inspect its current state.
服务端已确认收到请求，请刷新核对当前状态。
The server says you already registered
This step applies for the chapter. After the source refreshes, configure the node from My chapter applications. The two submissions are separate.
此步骤提交章节申请。源数据更新后，请在“我的章节申请”配置点位。两次提交分别处理。
Approval controls admission; it is not a platform endorsement.
通过仅代表准入，不代表平台背书。
The server rechecks current supply. Missing, duplicate or expired supply does not count as a completed review.
服务端将重新核对当前供给；供给不足、重复或过期时不视为复核完成。
Enter the service civil time as YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm. The source provides no timezone; the server validates eligibility.
请输入服务端本地时间 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm。源数据未提供时区，时间资格由服务端校验。
The source returned an application ID but no verified place ID. Claim withdrawal is unavailable.
源数据仅返回申请编号，没有已核实的地点编号，暂不能撤回认领。
This live code expired. Reload to request a new code.
此现场码已过期，请刷新获取新码。
Complete the source-required fields before review
请完成源契约要求的字段后再预览
I have checked the address and coordinates
The source changed after review. Reload and review again.
预览后源数据已发生变化，请重新加载并确认。
Current access does not permit this operation
当前权限不允许此操作
Live actions are disabled. Edits and reviews remain local; test requests use an injected offline transport only.
真实操作未启用。编辑和确认均保留在本地；测试请求仅使用注入的离线传输。
Review source records and prepare changes
查看源记录并准备变更
服务端提供的备援预案
人数限制，留空表示不限
More records exist beyond this source page
源页面之外还有记录未加载
Synthetic offline data. No business action is performed.
离线合成数据，不执行真实业务操作。
This review freezes the target and fields. Permissions and source data are checked again before dispatch.
此预览已冻结目标与字段，发送前会重新核对权限和源数据。
Check the requested fields and target
请核对请求字段与目标
An invitation is a pre-approved application, not just a message.
邀请会建立预先批准的申请，并非仅发送消息。
Time-limited live code. It is hidden on expiry.
现场码有有效期，到期后将隐藏。
Could not load the source. Retry when ready.
暂时无法加载源数据，请稍后重试。
Source data could not be safely read
Existing media references only. No image, audio or location is captured or uploaded.
仅编辑已有媒体引用；不会采集或上传图片、录音或位置。
未返回开放招募的章节
No host or participant workspace was returned
未返回主办或承接工作台
Node changes are submitted for source review. Applying does not mean winning the slot.
点位变更提交后由服务端处理审核；报名成功不等于中标。
This character belongs to this chapter node. Store-wide NPC settings are separate.
此角色属于当前章节点位，与店铺级形象分开管理。
No character has been configured for this node
A successful placement submission creates a pending application. It does not put the node online.
投放提交成功后形成待审申请，不代表据点已上线。
Poster code is separate from the time-limited live code
海报码与限时现场码分开使用
The original station receipt is terminal. Reload the current source state.
原本站回执已到终态，请重新加载当前源状态。
Route, node, template, award and settlement fields are fixed. Source dates remain unchanged. Empty capacity submits zero, meaning unlimited.
路线、站点、模板、中标和结算字段不可更改；保留原日期。人数留空将提交 0，表示不限。
Registration status could not be confirmed
暂时无法确认是否已报名
重试原冻结的本站请求
Check the receipt, then replay only the same station request if the server still permits it?
先核对回执；仅当服务端仍允许时，重放同一本站请求？
A server acknowledgement is not publication, a completed review or a successful financial result. Unknown outcomes stay locked.
服务端回执不代表发布、审核通过或资金操作成功；结果未知时保持锁定。
The signed-in account or session changed. Reopen this screen.
登录账号或会话已变更，请重新打开此页面。
The station receipt confirms this operation failed
本站回执确认操作失败
This affects only the selected merchant station
此操作仅影响所选商家站点
Recovery state could not be saved safely. Nothing was sent.
无法安全保存恢复状态，因此未发送请求。
Actual supply uses the separate cooperation workflow. An application ID is not an offer ID.
实际供给由独立合作流程处理；申请编号不是供给编号。
Supply context could not be loaded; other recruitment information remains available
暂时无法读取供给上下文，其他招募信息仍可查看
Terms are unavailable for this chapter; enrollment stays closed
未取得本章承接档位，暂不能申报供给
The result is unknown. Do not repeat this action. Only an exact terminal station receipt can release a station lock.
结果未知，请勿重复操作。本站锁仅可由完全匹配的终态回执解除。
Node voice uses one existing recording reference. Microphone, upload and provider generation are not enabled.
节点声音使用一段已有录音引用。麦克风、上传和供应商生成均未启用。
Exploration-value editing is unavailable: the retained source says the backend validates it without persisting it.
探索值暂不可编辑：保留的源记录表明后端会校验，但不会保存。
